entries.impact: An idle Desktop conversation cannot be resumed by the separate listener while its existing host retains a writer.
entries.evidence: Codex 0.158.0-alpha.2.1: thread/read succeeds; thread/resume returns RPC -32600 already has an active writer. A2A wake attempt wake:369a92b4-659b-423a-b2e3-b1a5e46f70a6 failed desktop_thread_unavailable.
entries.resolution: Did not delete locks or take over the Desktop writer. Message remained durable, then actual HTTP worker fetched/presented/ACKed via explicit Codex follow-up.
entries.follow_up: Need a supported connection to the owning host, or an explicit supported lifecycle handoff. Starting another listener is not sufficient proof of attaching to the live Desktop host.

entries.impact: Diagnostics alone can show wake_requested then agent_presented even when native wake failed; consumers must not infer native success from presentation.

entries.resolution: Saved wake-status, raw error summary and explicit fallback trigger together in native-wake-diagnosis.json.
entries.follow_up: Persist provider terminal failure reason and presentation trigger attribution without adding a new orchestration state machine.

entries.impact: Two initial open tasks duplicated already completed replacement work; cancellation has no owner to ACK and does not reach the documented cancelled state.

entries.resolution: Retained all failed-wake history and replacement IDs in cancellation reasons; no direct database changes or fabricated worker ACK.
entries.follow_up: Implement ownerless cancellation as an atomic main operation and reconcile assignment status in a separate repair; parent completion still requires user confirmation.
